nodes.description: 3-methylglutaconic aciduria during crises in the third patient, the first report of this marker in any Fe-S cluster deficiency. Its mechanism here is unknown.

evidence.reference_title: Iron-sulfur cluster ISD11 deficiency (LYRM4 gene) presenting as cardiorespiratory arrest and 3-methylglutaconic aciduria.
evidence.snippet: the first with 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, not reported in any Fe-S cluster deficiency

nodes.description: Mitochondrial aconitase (ACO2, a TCA-cycle enzyme) and cytosolic aconitase (ACO1) both lose activity. Cytosolic aconitase without its cluster becomes iron regulatory protein 1.

evidence.reference_title: Human ISD11 is essential for both iron-sulfur cluster assembly and maintenance of normal cellular iron homeostasis.
evidence.snippet: Using RNA-interference techniques, we have shown that suppression of human ISD11 inactivated mitochondrial and cytosolic aconitases.

nodes.description: Admission and intravenous fluid with 5 per cent dextrose in normal saline during catabolic states, to limit the energy demand the residual oxidative capacity cannot meet. This is supportive care, not a therapy directed at the assembly defect.

nodes.description: The residual oxidative capacity is enough between crises but fails under the demand of an intercurrent infection, producing lethargy, ketosis and cardiorespiratory arrest. The link from complex deficiency to the arrest is inferred from the biochemistry and the clinical timing.

evidence.reference_title: Iron-sulfur cluster ISD11 deficiency (LYRM4 gene) presenting as cardiorespiratory arrest and 3-methylglutaconic aciduria.
evidence.snippet: Remarkably, it appears to be no neurological involvement so far, only with life-threating acute crisis triggered by expectably benign autolimited illnesses.

nodes.description: Client apoproteins do not receive their clusters, so several Fe-S proteins are lost together in patient tissue: subunits of complexes I, II and III, mitochondrial and cytosolic aconitase, and ferrochelatase. This is the convergence point of the disease mechanism.
nodes.id: Failure to Mature Fe-S Client Proteins

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in LYRM4, encoding iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis factor ISD11, cause deficiency of multiple respiratory chain complexes.
evidence.snippet: Several other Fe-S proteins were also affected in both patients, including the aconitases and ferrochelatase.

nodes.description: Ferrochelatase, the [2Fe-2S] enzyme that inserts iron into protoporphyrin IX in the last step of heme synthesis, is deficient in patient tissue. No anemia or porphyrin phenotype is described in the reported patients.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in LYRM4, encoding iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis factor ISD11, cause deficiency of multiple respiratory chain complexes.
evidence.snippet: Several other Fe-S proteins were also affected in both patients, including the aconitases and ferrochelatase.

nodes.description: With oxidative phosphorylation blocked, pyruvate is reduced to lactate. Lactate rises in blood, and in the third patient only during crises.

evidence.reference_title: Iron-sulfur cluster ISD11 deficiency (LYRM4 gene) presenting as cardiorespiratory arrest and 3-methylglutaconic aciduria.
evidence.snippet: During acute events of illness, she had hyperlactacidemia (maximum lactate 5.2 mmol/L)

nodes.description: Homozygous germline missense variants in LYRM4, p.Arg68Leu (c.203G>T) in the founding family and p.Tyr31Cys (c.92A>G) in the second family. Arg68 sits in the third helix of ISD11, which contacts NFS1. No truncating patient allele is known, consistent with ISD11 being essential.

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in LYRM4, encoding iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis factor ISD11, cause deficiency of multiple respiratory chain complexes.
evidence.snippet: The homozygous mutation (c.203G>T, p.R68L) was identified via massively parallel sequencing of >1000 mitochondrial genes (MitoExome sequencing)

evidence.reference_title: The Nfs1 interacting protein Isd11 has an essential role in Fe/S cluster biogenesis in mitochondria.
evidence.snippet: we identified a novel essential protein of the mitochondrial matrix, which is highly conserved from yeast to human and which we termed Isd11

nodes.description: Apo-cytosolic aconitase binds iron-responsive elements as IRP1, IRP2 rises, and cells misread their iron status. Ferric iron accumulates in punctate deposits, and the R68L variant raises mitochondrial iron and reactive oxygen species.
nodes.id: IRP1 Activation and Cellular Iron Dysregulation

evidence.reference_title: Human ISD11 is essential for both iron-sulfur cluster assembly and maintenance of normal cellular iron homeostasis.
evidence.snippet: ISD11 suppression activated iron-responsive element-binding activity of iron regulatory protein 1, increased protein levels of iron regulatory protein 2, and resulted in abnormal punctate ferric iron accumulations in cells

evidence.reference_title: Mapping Key Residues of ISD11 Critical for NFS1-ISD11 Subcomplex Stability: IMPLICATIONS IN THE DEVELOPMENT OF MITOCHONDRIAL DISORDER, COXPD19.
evidence.snippet: the R68L ISD11 mutant displayed accumulation of mitochondrial iron and reactive oxygen species

nodes.description: Reduced sulfur supply blocks de novo cluster synthesis on the ISCU scaffold. Because this is the first step of the ISC pathway, all downstream mitochondrial and cytosolic Fe-S proteins are at risk, unlike the late-acting MMDS factors that affect only [4Fe-4S] clients.
nodes.id: Impaired Early-Step Mitochondrial Iron-Sulfur Cluster Assembly

evidence.reference_title: Mutations in LYRM4, encoding iron-sulfur cluster biogenesis factor ISD11, cause deficiency of multiple respiratory chain complexes.
evidence.snippet: Our findings are consistent with a defect in the early step of ISC assembly affecting a broad variety of Fe-S proteins.

nodes.description: Raised blood lactate, up to 5.2 mmol/L during crises in the third patient and normal after recovery; lactic acidosis in the newborn patients.

nodes.description: Oral carnitine was given to the third patient for her low free carnitine and later stopped. No benefit beyond correcting the carnitine level is reported, so this addresses a biochemical finding rather than the disease.

nodes.description: NFS1 releases sulfur from L-cysteine as a persulfide for cluster assembly on ISCU. With R68L ISD11 this activity is barely detectable in vitro.

evidence.snippet: Our in vitro studies showed that the l-cysteine desulfurase activity of NFS1 was barely present when co-expressed with mutant ISD11.

nodes.description: Complexes I, II and III each contain Fe-S clusters and are deficient in patient muscle and liver. Complex IV, which has no Fe-S cluster, was also low in the muscle of the more severe cousin and of the third patient, presumably a secondary effect. Patient fibroblasts were largely spared.

nodes.description: ISD11 forms a stable complex with NFS1 and, with acyl carrier protein (ACP), holds it in an active conformation. Its role is regulatory rather than catalytic. The R68L variant lowers the affinity of ISD11 for NFS1.
